author: jracer15
body: I had a discussion with Evocal the struggles of being a map dev I was wondering if there should be people to help the map devs, one thing he mention was how it was hard to test maps since you would need several to test it, if they were a group rank (idk Map Testers, the avicus team can pick something better then my nooby mind) they could basically be assistance to the map devs.  And the current map devs (Evocal and ParaSpider, and whoever else i don't know becuase I'm a idiot) could be bosses to these testers or assistants. Maybe add ranks to Map Devs (Jr.MapDevs, idk I'm really not that bright). They're is a lot of maps being submitted in and its hard for them to give answers on the progress for any of them. If Evocal sees this I'm only trying to help him, I don't like stress on anyone and for someone being kind to accept maps in I really want it to be a good thing. It would be help the map makers and the map devs. Hopefully someone can reply and make this idea into reality!

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
I guess the bottom line is that we have many excited map builders, and a need on the server to get new content published ( the server wants to grow correct?), the problem is how do we get more " good " information to the map builders and unplug the implementation bottle neck that we currently have (and we do have one).  

The map builders are asking for more updates - is it accepted, any map errors, is the map conditionally accepted and if everything is good, what is the ETA for the map to be released into rotation.

The Map Devs. struggle with getting YMLs correct on "The Walls" maps, Have a testing cycle that sometimes requires more help, and then the updates to the back end of the file and server systems.

Map Devs. What can we do to better the process? Something as simple as an excel spread sheet could be published and updated to show the maps, the status, and the eta to test, and then a projected release date. This sheet could have all the maps, game modes, and accepted or rejected status. More information could provide where the map is in the processing cycle before release along with any critical errors or needs etc.

Doing this would fix the "Consumer" or "map builder" portion of the problem - the Dev problem , well is still a map dev problem as far as the processing of the maps go.... 

Thoughts?

replies.body: ParaSpider, I had a conversation with Evocal about how it was struggling to be map devs testing these things out (the YML Polar mentioned), and how he had a hard time doing it on his own (remember, his words) there is a simple option which is get more people involved into this.  I'm sure its annoying being asked when a map is being accepted but you have a hard time answering that. I know Evocal did when I did.  All I want is there to not be this road block into the discussion of maps.  In the case that is YML well then that road block will always stay there until it is a more knowledgeable thing, but I think there needs to be giving help to the map devs, maybe you didnt see it as a problem ParaSpider, and maybe its just the walls thats is the difficult part but if so, Evocal said its the walls thats difficult to get by and I'm saying he needs help, and if its in genral walls is a hard to get by there is plenty of people who can help, I just don't this to be problem, I'm trying to come up with solutions.
